newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Gresik to buy 25-pct stake in Varia.
newsitem.headline: Gresik to buy 25-pct stake in Varia.

text.p: Indonesian large cement maker PT Semen Gresik said on Monday it planned to buy a 25-percent stake in ready mixed concrete producer PT Varia Usaha Beton for 8.3 billion rupiah.
"The firm plans to invest in PT Varia Usaha Beton (VUB), with total investment value of 8.3 billion rupiah," Semen Gresik said in a statement.
Semen Gresik expected to hold a shareholders meeting on June 19 to obtain shareholders's approval, it said.
VUB posted a net profit of 3.98 billion rupiah in 1996 against 2.90 billion rupiah in 1995, Semen Gresik said.

After the share purchase, VUB will be 47.5-percent owned by privately-owned PT Varia Usaha, 27.5 percent by Semen Gresik Pension Funds (Dana Pensiun Semen Gresik), and the remaining 25 percent by Semen Gresik.
VUB is currently 63.3 percent owned by PT Varia Usaha and the remaining 36.7 percent is held by Semen Gresik Pension Funds.
